verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ADK's workflow orchestration (a graph-based runtime with loops, retry and fan-out) and deployment to Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, GKE or Docker. None of it shows a built-in way to schedule workflows on a recurring basis (cron-like triggers or time-based runs). In-workflow loops and host-platform deployment targets are adjacent features, not recurring scheduling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
